spots.name: Little Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 243 m (797 ft).

spots.name: James Ross Wildlife Reservation
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Shivar Springs Bottling Company Cisterns
spots.tip: A landmark with history. Low light brings out texture; check opening hours if it's fenced.

spots.tip: A mapped viewpoint facing northwest. Good for sunset. Arrive 30 minutes early to scout foreground.

spots.name: Pacolet Water Falls
spots.tip: Best under soft overcast or in shade so the highlights don't blow out. A slow shutter (1/4–1 s on a tripod) smooths the water; flow peaks after rain and snowmelt.
